video_title: KD vs. Iman, New-Look Lakers & PG On The Celtics

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert praises Olivia Miles' competitive drive
quotes.excerpt: She's trying to win. She's not trying to lose a fucking game, bro.
quotes.quote: I love that about Olivia Miles. She's trying to win. She's not trying to lose a fucking game, bro.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert calls Kevin Durant one of the best basketball trolls
quotes.excerpt: KD is one of the best basketball trolls that has ever existed.
quotes.quote: KD is one of the best basketball trolls that has ever existed.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert stands by his claim that KD's move to Golden State cost him two rings
quotes.excerpt: You're definitely a champion. But let's get this out of the way. You shouldn't have did it.
quotes.quote: You're definitely a champion. But let's get this out of the way. You shouldn't have did it. You're definitely a champion, but even though he went and joined some people that they already came from winning and they had established a record, they needed him or they couldn't beat us again. I feel that way.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert compares Charles Barkley's legacy to a Game of Thrones character
quotes.excerpt: Charles Barkley dying on the hill with the sword in hand. He on some Game of Thrones shit.
quotes.quote: Charles Barkley dying on the hill with the sword in hand. He on some Game of Thrones shit. My dog fought everybody, and it's just like he just didn't have enough to beat black. That's cool, dog. That's cool to me that it's like his story is what it is, his legend is what it is, we still respect him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert believes Ausar Thompson will be worth his contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Ausar Thompson, especially once he develops really just the confidence in his jump shots, he is going to be low-key way more worth it.
quotes.quote: Ausar Thompson, especially once he develops really just the confidence in his jump shots, he is going to be low-key way more worth it. Anybody that has an issue with it is going to say it's because he can't shoot as well or whatever, but at some point being in the league, you're just going to start knocking down shots. It's repetition, it's being in these situations over and over and over. He's going to develop the confidence to knock down his shot.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the difficulty of learning to play defense in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: Learning how to defend is not a learning thing. It's more are you athletically gifted?
quotes.quote: Learning how to defend is not a learning thing. It's more are you athletically gifted? Do you have the height? Do you have just the physical gifts? Do you have the wingspan? Are you strong enough? Are you explosive enough? And then can you react and can you anticipate? I think that's a good 80% of especially playing defense now in today's league. It's a good 80% guessing game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert questions why James Harden is not playing in the post
quotes.excerpt: I for the life of me don't understand why James Harden isn't in the post yet.
quotes.quote: I for the life of me don't understand why James Harden isn't in the post yet. No, I'm serious, though. At the end of the day, James, you have changed the game completely into where the step-back can leave a defender at bay where it just keeps their rhythm off. There's no way to keep somebody from getting space anymore if they can prove that they can step back and bust a three.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on James Harden's ability to create space
quotes.excerpt: If he decides one day, I'm shooting pull-ups, I don't care how old he is, a lot of people can't stop James Harden.
quotes.quote: If he decides one day, I'm shooting pull-ups, I don't care how old he is, a lot of people can't stop James Harden. He just has to, he got to win.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Paul George's fit with the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I think Paul George is going to play some good basketball in Boston because it's going to be predicated for him.
quotes.quote: I think Paul George is going to play some good basketball in Boston because it's going to be predicated for him. They get a lot of threes up. Paul George is at the point of his career where that's comfortable for him. He doesn't have to do as much wiggling and beating up his body. He can just play good basketball, good spacing, get them feet set and let that thing go.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert doubts DeMar DeRozan's fit with the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: It's going to be interesting to see him with them, because it's not going to make sense to the playoffs.
quotes.quote: It's going to be interesting to see him with them, because it's not going to make sense to the playoffs to me. I think that we'd have all these complaints, there's going to be opinionated back and forth and then the playoffs are going to hit and DeMar is going to make a lot of sense over there because Jokic spreads the floor, Jamal spreads the floor. They always have spacers, and then DeMar is going to give them the stability of saying, I can get a bucket or I can get to the free throw line and we can make this a chess game.
